191	  component changes. Climb the customization ladder
192	  (global token → component CSS API → narrow flagged hack) before ever

211	  (`scripts/icon-image-search.sh`) or on gravity-ui.com/icons; the

191	> If you need this library, read more at package [llms.txt](https://gravity-ui.com/llms/dashkit/llms.txt)
192	> GitHub: [gravity-ui/dashkit](https://github.com/gravity-ui/dashkit)

Since `setSeries` with incremental pushes into `yagr.config.timeline` and concats into `matched.data` — the chart mutates the arrays I passed in config (matched.data is my array; `matched.data.concat(data)` creates new array assigned back to matched.data; and timeline: `this.config.timeline.push(...timeline)` mutates my array). Cleaner approach: manage data in my own refs, and on each tick:
```ts
timeline.push(t); timeline.shift();
data.push(v); data.shift();
yagr.setSeries([t], [{id: 'cpu', data: [v]}], {incremental: true, splice: true});
```

```ts

yagr.setSeries([t], [{id: 'cpu', data: [v]}], {incremental: true, splice: true});
